profile.name: 快速XAFS扫描控制组件
profile.description: 用于配置和执行快速X射线吸收精细结构扫描的非实体软件组件。它负责连接扫描相关控制点、生成基于能量与停留时间的运动轨迹、启动扫描采集、将聚集数据换算为能量信息，并在扫描结束后整理与保存数据。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for configuring and executing quick X-ray absorption fine structure scans. It connects scan-related control points, generates motion trajectories from energy and dwell settings, starts scan acquisition, converts gathered data into energy-related results, and performs post-scan data handling and saving.
